name: OpenCode - ${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}
initializeCommand:
echo -e "# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM ${localEnv:DEVCONTAINER_BASE_IMAGE:mcr.microsoft.com/devcontainers/base}:${localEnv:DEVCONTAINER_BASE_IMAGE_TAG:ubuntu-24.04}
ARG _DEV_CONTAINERS_IMAGE_USER
RUN cat /etc/passwd
RUN ls -la /root
RUN <<EOF
    CURRENT_HOME=\$(getent passwd "\${_DEV_CONTAINERS_IMAGE_USER}" | cut -d: -f6)
    CURRENT_GROUP=\$(getent passwd "\${_DEV_CONTAINERS_IMAGE_USER}" | cut -d: -f4 | xargs getent group | cut -d: -f1)
    TARGET_HOME="/home/\${_DEV_CONTAINERS_IMAGE_USER}"
    if [ "\${CURRENT_HOME}" != "\${TARGET_HOME}" ]; then
        echo "Current home is \${CURRENT_HOME}. Updating to \${TARGET_HOME}..."
        mv "\${CURRENT_HOME}" "\${TARGET_HOME}"
        sed -i "s|:\${CURRENT_HOME}:|:\${TARGET_HOME}:|" /etc/passwd
    else
        echo "Home directory is already set to \$TARGET_HOME."
    fi
EOF" > .opencode/runtime_data/Dockerfile
